title: Hold a parking bay licence in the Perth parking management area
what: Permit parking on non-residential land or buildings in the Perth parking management area only under a parking bay licence (which carries a licence fee).

sources.title: Perth Parking Management Act 1999 (WA)
sources.quote: The owner of land or a building in the Perth parking management area must not permit a vehicle to be parked on the land or in or on the building unless — (a) the land or building is used solely for private residential purposes; or (b) the owner has a parking bay licence that permits the vehicle to be parked there;
